Projects.title: From design to delivery
Projects.description: A selection of projects showcasing my approach to software architecture, modernization, and development.

hexagonal-modernization.title: Application Modernization
hexagonal-modernization.description: Progressively modernizing applications toward a hexagonal architecture.

problem: Evolve legacy applications toward a more modular and maintainable architecture.
Carry out this modernization while continuing to maintain existing applications.
decisions: Apply hexagonal architecture principles to decouple the application core from technical dependencies.
tradeoffs: Temporarily maintain both the legacy and new architectures.
Balance efforts between maintaining existing systems and modernizing them.
results: Contributed to the modernization of a set of applications.
Implemented an architecture designed to improve modularity and extensibility.

deployment-dashboard.title: Application Deployment Monitoring
deployment-dashboard.description: Designing a tool to simplify application deployment monitoring.

problem: Simplify deployment monitoring across a large application portfolio.
decisions: Contribute to the implementation of a dedicated deployment monitoring dashboard.
results: Delivered a tool for monitoring deployments across an application portfolio.

ai-modernization.title: AI Agents and Software Modernization
ai-modernization.description: Exploring how AI agents can support application modernization.

problem: Explore the possibilities offered by AI agents in software modernization activities.
decisions: Experiment with AI agents to support application analysis and evolution.
Investigate their potential contribution to technology migration initiatives.
results: Exploratory work on the use of AI agents in software development.

portfolio.title: Professional Portfolio
portfolio.description: Building a professional portfolio with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

problem: Present my professional background and technical achievements through a professional portfolio.
decisions: Separate application data from presentation components.
Use Tailwind CSS to build a responsive interface.
